# Reading font fixtures

These four original test fonts were generated with opentype.js 2.0.0 (MIT).
They contain only a `.notdef` glyph and the letter `A`, drawn as a triangle.
Their deliberately distinct advances identify actual face selection in the
browser: Regular 400, Bold 800, Italic 600, BoldItalic 1000 font units.
They share the embedded family `Foliole Test Reading`, with OS/2 weights
400/700 and upright/italic flags. Filenames do not define their family.
The fixture outlines contain no third-party font artwork.
